Subject: MAP checkpoint — quick clarifications on retention & PII

Diego / team,

Thanks for the MAP draft — we're reviewing and have a few gating questions the security and procurement teams asked us to lock down before the pilot kickoff: 

1) If we run Redwood Private in our VPC, can we get a firm retention SLA for KV/prefix caches and any temporary logs? ACME policy requires maximum 30-day retention for derived caches unless explicitly retained.

2) For on-prem (air-gapped) installs: what parts of the telemetry pipeline are optional? Our security team needs to ensure nothing leaves the network without express permission.

3) PII: we have mixed customer content in prompts. Can you confirm whether Redwood's standard Private deployment offers a configuration toggle to enforce PII masking at ingest (token redaction) and whether that is supported for both hosted and on-prem variants?

We'd like to resolve these items by EOD Wednesday (17th) to hit the timeline in the MAP. Can we do a short call tomorrow to run through?

Thanks,
Tyler

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint — quick clarifications on retention & PII

Tyler — thanks, this is helpful. Short answers up front, then a brief MAP-oriented note and action items below. I'll also attach an updated MAP + deployment diagram.

Short answers:
- Retention: For Redwood Private in a VPC, retention windows for caches/logs are configurable per-tenant. We can set default max retention to 30 days and provide a compliance report. Permanent retention requires an explicit config and an authorization audit trail.
- Telemetry on on-prem: Telemetry is optional. We ship a lightweight agent that can be disabled; offline diagnostics can be exported manually. Automatic outbound telemetry (metrics/traces) is opt-in for air-gapped installs.
- PII masking: We support configurable ingest redaction (rule-based and regex) at the edge for Private and on-prem. For hosted customers, we recommend application-side redaction plus Redwood's masking layer — but for Private VPC installs you can enable server-side enforcement.

MAP checkpoint (summary):
- Goal: Pilot ACME ingestion into Redwood Private (VPC) for evaluation by end of Q3.
- Current blockers: final retention SLA, contract addendum for on-prem telemetry, and confirmation of PII enforcement in deployment template.

Action items (owners & ETA):
1) Diego — draft retention SLA language (30-day default, exception process) and send to procurement (ETA: 2026-06-16 EOD). Attachment: ACME_MAP_v1.2.pdf
2) Neha — produce a minimal telemetry runbook for air-gapped installs and checkbox options for outbound telemetry (ETA: 2026-06-16 12:00 PDT). Attachment: security-questionnaire-filled.xlsx
3) Marissa — confirm commercial impact of retention exceptions and proposed addendum for Private installs (ETA: 2026-06-17 COB).
4) ACME / Tyler — confirm whether you need server-side PII redaction enforced by config or if client-side redaction suffices for pilot (ETA: 2026-06-17).

Proposed 30-minute sync: Tue 2026-06-16 10:00 PT — please confirm. I'll include a short slide with the deployment diagram.

Attached: ACME_MAP_v1.2.pdf, redwood-deployment-diagram.png

Regards,

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint — quick clarifications on retention & PII

Tyler / Diego,

Attaching the filled security questionnaire and a short runbook for telemetry options. Highlights:
- Telemetry: agent can be deployed in "no-export" mode (metrics stored locally, manual bundle for Redwood support). This satisfies air-gapped requirements but limits proactive health checks.
- Logs vs. caches: we classify KV/prefix caches as ephemeral by default; we can enforce automatic eviction at 30 days. Audit logs (who changed config) are recommended to be retained longer but can be routed to ACME's SIEM via S3/Kinesis in VPC setups.
- PII redaction: we provide two enforcement layers: a) pre-ingest regex-based redaction (configurable), b) post-response scrub for LLM outputs. For strict PII policies we recommend enabling both.

Action: I will add explicit config toggles to the questionnaire and flag which options are incompatible with air-gapped installs. See attachment: security-questionnaire-filled.xlsx

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Tyler, Diego — quick commercial note to keep the MAP timeline realistic.

- Retention default to 30 days: no commercial delta.
- Requests for permanent retention of KV caches or logs will need a contract addendum and may incur an engineering review fee (one-time).
- Air-gapped support (no outbound telemetry) is included with our Private plan for pilot customers, but long-term monitored SLAs require an always-on support bundle.

If ACME confirms pilot uses the 30-day default and server-side PII redaction, I can lock pricing for the pilot and update the MAP milestones to show a Go/No-Go decision on 2026-07-15.

I'll follow up with a redline to the MAP addendum tonight.

-Marissa
